name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by countless hours spent watching Formula 1 races with his father. After graduating with a degree in Communications, he started his career in a local racing team, handling everything from social media to sponsorship proposals. His knack for crafting compelling narratives and building strong relationships quickly caught the attention of larger organizations. 

At Hot Racing Team, Jean-Pierre focuses on enhancing the team's public image and securing valuable partnerships. He believes in transparency and authenticity, striving to connect with fans on a deeper level. His data-driven approach to PR, combined with his creative flair, ensures that every campaign is both impactful and measurable. He is known for his ability to handle crises with calm and professionalism, always putting the team's best interests first.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze and a warm smile.
